[!dolt] skip
# Test bd children includes closed children
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Parent epic' --description 'Owns child work' --type epic --json
extractid PARENT
bd create 'Child one' --description 'Open child' --parent $PARENT --json
extractid CHILD1
bd create 'Child two' --description 'Will be closed' --parent $PARENT --json
extractid CHILD2
bd close $CHILD2 --reason Done

bd children $PARENT --json
jq 'length'
stdout '^2$'
stdout 'Child one'
stdout 'Child two'
